summary: @flexmr/ui dependency-confusion package exfiltrates host identity on install
details: @flexmr/ui@99.99.99 is a scope-squatting placeholder on public npm with package.json declaring preinstall, install, and postinstall all invoking `node beacon.js`, so the payload fires automatically on `npm install`. beacon.js collects os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.cwd(), platform, node version, package name, and the lifecycle event, then transmits them via HTTP GET to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://177.7.60.239:48080 and via a DNS lookup against the hardcoded callback domain oob.recon.dev. The 99.99.99 version is the standard dependency-confusion overshoot used to win resolution against an internal `@flexmr/ui`; any build that references that name will resolve this public package and execute the beacon. Publisher control of this scope slot additionally enables arbitrary future payloads to replace the current identity beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
